text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan came to the Trainer's Office, seemingly wishing to talk about something, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
As you know, Trainer, with the condition of my legs,
I can't afford repeated trial and error like the others.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
That is why I want you to judge
when the right time for me to run is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, whenever you deem it necessary for me
to enter a race, I will give it everything I have.
I look forward to continuing to work with you.

Mejiro Ardan doesn't show it on her face,
but fatigue from her races seems to be piling up.
It might be best to reconsider her race schedule.
